summary.name: Remaker AI
summary.one_liner: Remaker AI is a web-based AI creative platform for editing, enhancing, and generating images and short videos using prompts or preset photo effects.
use_cases: Apply AI style transfer to photos
Create short viral videos for Reels, TikTok, or Shorts
summary.what_it_does: Remaker AI lets users edit, enhance, and generate images from simple text prompts or by applying dozens of AI photo effects and templates. Its image tools cover photo restoration, background removal, style transfer, and image upscaling. It also includes AI video generation and a library of trending entertainment templates for short vertical videos. The page says no technical knowledge is needed and that each tool page has step-by-step tutorials. Content can be produced in multiple languages, including English, Chinese, Japanese, and German.
notable: Credit-based, one-time purchases with no recurring subscription
Free credits for new users that can export watermark-free images and videos
Payments processed by Stripe, accepting cards, Google Pay, and Apple Pay
caveats: Advanced features and extra credits require upgrading to VIP
Credit packages range from $5.99 for 200 credits to $299 for 20,000 credits
Many basic features are free, but the full feature set is paid
